newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable despite campaign violence.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable despite campaign violence.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in dull early trading on Wednesday despite violence in the general election campaign on Tuesday, dealers said.

They said the rupiah was stable, even firming slightly, considering the longer maturity of the spot date. Spot rupiah, due May 27 because of a public holiday on Thursday in Jakarta and on Monday in the United States, was quoted at 2,442.75/43.50 at 0300 GMT, little changed from the opening at 2,442.0/44.0.
Dealers said the absence of Singapore players because of a holiday there reduced trading volumes to a minimum.
One state bank dealer said there was no follow-through in the market on Wednesday after the rupiah was knocked down about three points on Tuesday following news of campaign violence.
"London operators seemed to have suffered some losses as the violence failed to drive the rupiah down," the dealer said.
However, operators remained cautious in the last leg of the campaign for the May 29 elections. The campaign ends on Friday.

One Japanese bank dealer said operators were relieved after the U.S. Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged. He said interest rate differentials between the rupiah and the dollar were narrowing and a hike could complicate local rates.
